verdict.rationale: Docs confirm each DGX B200 GPU is part of an 8-GPU node with 1,440GB total GPU memory (180GB per GPU) and 14.4TB/s NVLink bandwidth, easily sufficient for single-GPU 70B-class quantized inference, and community posts note it's usable on-demand and outperforms H200. Missing for 10: explicit per-GPU HBM memory bandwidth spec (TB/s) and a concrete 70B quantized inference benchmark/throughput number.
